name: github-workflow
description: Community plugin for GitHub-based development workflows. Say 'start the next story' and the plugin picks an issue from your backlog, plans the architecture, builds the implementation, runs tests, and opens a PR. Supports sprint-based and flat backlogs with configurable label mappings. Bundles 7 skills, 9 commands, and 3 agents with least-privilege tool access. Includes an interactive setup wizard that auto-detects your project configuration.
